design_rule: Layered PNG scene + editable scientific interpretation

layers.name: evidence_surface
layers.implementation: source-derived Fig3 Panel A and Panel B crops with backplates

layers.name: interpretation_layer
layers.implementation: editable-equivalent title, callout, and corner focus windows

layers.name: trust_status_layer
layers.implementation: short shared-row comparability label; no raw paths in visible slide

layers.name: motion_focus_layer
layers.implementation: single transition from aggregate comparison to tissue deltas

claim_boundary: Only shared six-task rows are direct model comparisons; tissue deltas are matched local comparisons, not a universal model ranking.
